stage2_patch.explanation: Added an authentication guard immediately after the opening PHP tag in install.php. The guard starts the session, then checks the project's existing login sentinel $_SESSION["login"]. If the user is not logged in, it redirects to login.php and exits before any installation logic can run. This blocks unauthorized direct access while preserving access for authenticated users, consistent with existing guard semantics in backdoor.php and security.php.
